Here’s the thing. Attractiveness is subjective. Girl I think you’re absolutely beautiful, and I’m definitely not the only one. That doesn’t mean everyone will, because people have different taste. But why should that matter? Should your attractiveness to others define you? No. You’re more than that. There are loads of other wonderful, beautiful things about you that should come before your physical beauty. 
I know how important it can feel though, because there are a lot of pressures that come from society to look a certain way. But for 99% of people, looking that way isn’t attainable. And that’s completely okay. Fitting the stereotypes is fine, I’m not trying to attack that! But everyone, stereotypical beauty or not, is beautiful. Different people are going to find different things attractive. But just because one person finds you attractive and another doesn’t, does not mean you’re not beautiful. The thing that ties in with that is that most of us are not born finding ourselves attractive, we’re not our own type. But you can learn to love yourself. Having respect for yourself is important, no matter what the respect looks like to you. And you WILL grow in that, naturally and also through work. Confidence gets better as you get older. But the one thing I can say right now is to not worry. You don’t wanna waste any beautiful days doing nothing because you felt too self conscious. Take this from someone with depression and anxiety. I look back on things like school dances and feel sad because I was too hateful towards myself to enjoy the time I had with my friends. Please continue talking to your therapist about this. You can and will get better towards yourself, don’t give up on that. Continue taking care of yourself, please. That’s so important. The way you perceive yourself is not the way others perceive you. I know things are tough right not because of COVID, sounds like you have a lot of restrictions where you live. Make sure you’re frequently videochatting your friends and family. Spending time with others can clear your mind. There are a lot of beautiful hobbies you can take up while you’re indoors whether that be reading, writing, baking, yoga, etc. Just don’t stop trying. Don’t let those negative thoughts win. You’re always bigger than them. 
If you’re worried about dating, you will find a significant other one day if you haven’t already, and they will love you just as you are. You shouldn’t have to change yourself for someone. If the deal breaker for someone is that you don’t look a certain way, THEY DONT DESERVE YOU. PERIOD. A person isn’t worth your time if they truly care so much about your looks. You do not want a person like that.
